constraints: original_tensor must have right dtype, size, dims, and device
original_tensor must be a positive multiple of the minimum sparse block size, given in _DTYPE_TO_SHAPE_CONSTRAINTS for each dtype (float32, float16, bfloat16, int8)

transposed.description: deprecated arg to be removed in another release. Do not use.

output.description: A sparse semi-structured tensor created from the given original_tensor
